title: Beyond-Birthday-Bound Hash-CTR-Hash Modes
summary: HCTR2 is secure only to the birthday bound; the open task is to design an efficient Hash-CTR-Hash tweakable enciphering mode with provable beyond-birthday-bound security.

formal_statement.body: HCTR2 is a provably secure Hash--CTR--Hash tweakable enciphering mode and an alternative to XCB, but its security is limited to the birthday bound. The open problem is to design a more robust tweakable enciphering mode that retains the efficient Hash--CTR--Hash structure while achieving provable beyond-birthday-bound security.

scope.domain: Design of tweakable enciphering modes based on the efficient Hash-CTR-Hash architecture.
parameters: Security threshold — the desired proof must extend beyond HCTR2's birthday-bound limitation
scope.unresolved_remainder: Design a more robust tweakable enciphering mode that retains the efficient Hash-CTR-Hash structure and has provable beyond-birthday-bound security.

citations.label: Breaking the IEEE Encryption Standard -- XCB-AES in Two Queries

progress.summary: The paper explicitly poses this in its open-problems discussion, citing HCTR2's birthday-bound limitation and describing GEM as ongoing work toward the stronger guarantee.
